blocks.x: Exceptions auto-resolved at 74%, control tower to agentic remediation

A global 3PL (40+ countries), a Logistics & Supply Chain engagement delivered by a blended Achala IT Solutions team under the outcome-linked engagement model. Identity withheld as standard; the figures are the client's, reproduced with permission.
Visibility stitched from carrier portals; ETAs updated by phone.
Exception queues consumed 60% of ops capacity. Carrier fraud (double-brokering) rising.

The event spine unified TMS/WMS/telematics/carrier events on Forge; Nexus decision policies route exceptions; Swarm agents remediate the recoverable classes (document mismatches, rebookings, detention claims) within policy. Carrier identity verification closed the fraud vector.

blocks.x: What would change in your estate

What transferred directly from the global 3PL (40+ countries) program: the decision pattern and the evidence design. What never transfers: the estate's quirks, which is why every program re-runs the baseline diagnostic on its own data before any build The engagement model here was outcome-linked; the same pattern runs fixed-scope where the estate allows it.
